svg.title: Row groups in a Parquet file pass through three checks in order: our in-memory dynamic index, the footer min/max statistics, then Parquet bloom filters. Each check removes some row groups. The rest are decoded with filters pushed down, so the output is not the whole row group, and a partial view must never become an index.
svg.text: all row groups in the file
what comes out is not the row group

figure.figcaption: Cheapest check first. DataFusion does the predicate logic; the dynamic index only has to answer questions about row groups.
